newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen in new upmove, called higher.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen in new upmove, called higher.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
London cocoa is due 10 stg up and may be poised for a new move higher, traders and analysts said on Friday.

Benchmark July is likely to break 1,019 stg a tonne and then find support for a move to 1,038, according to Trevor Neil, a senior technical analyst at Union CAL Ltd. "I would expect it to be quite swift," he said. Then it would face resistance at 1,060, he said.
Neil described Friday's expected rise as "probably a very important move".
New York futures rallied sharply on Thursday as chart-driven speculative buying drove the key July contract to its highest settlement in six weeks, dealers said.

Traders said the market may have received support from talk that the upcoming 1997/98 Ivorian main crop could be delayed due to drought conditions earlier this year, which has kept soil moisture below optimum levels.

Additionally, talk that the Ivory Coast mid-crop would not be as good as expected due to poor quality beans may have added fuel to the rally. And weather patterns suggesting dry weather could hit Brazil and Africa were also viewed as friendly.
LIFFE cocoa futures erased morning losses in Thursday afternoon trade to end higher, on the heels of the stronger-than-expected New York open.
